fact: ONECI, under the Interior Ministry, manages the RNPP and attributes the national identification number, per the PARAE coordinator.
ONECI, the Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification, is the only body authorised to issue the secure national identity card, through enrolment centres such as Grand-Bassam.
ONECI states the RNPP has been deployed since 2019 as a public-private partnership in which the operator SEMLEX runs the project, reviewed at a May 2026 workshop.
MOSIP says it trained participants from Cote d'Ivoire at IIIT-Bangalore in 2025 to support system operations, alongside a pilot with local capacity building.
ONECI is described as the identification authority responsible for enrolment, production and management of identity in Cote d'Ivoire.
ONECI, the national authority, produces and manages the national ID card and the RNPP, according to its director-general.
